title: Finite etale restriction to a punctured power-series section is injective
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], d a positive integer, and B = A[[x_1,...,x_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Let z:Spec A -> Spec B be the constant-coefficient zero-section immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let V be an open of Spec B with z^{-1}(V) equal to Spec A minus its closed point, and put V_0 = V times_{Spec B} Spec A. For every pair P,Q of finite etale V-schemes, the restriction map Hom_V(P,Q) -> Hom_{V_0}(P|V_0,Q|V_0) is injective. No normality, integrality, connectedness or nonempty-cover hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the new structure-sheaf comparison to obtain a surjection from the local power-series ring B to Gamma(V,O). The punctured spectrum of A is nonempty: otherwise PrimeSpectrum(A) would be a singleton, so its Krull dimension would be at most zero, contradicting depth(A)>=2 and the depth-support-dimension bound. The punctured section gives a point x_0 of z^{-1}(V) and hence a point of V. Evaluation at that point makes Gamma(V,O) nontrivial. A nontrivial quotient of a local ring is local, so Gamma(V,O) has only idempotents zero and one. The proved connectedness-idempotent criterion then makes V connected.

Choose the constructed geometric point s=algClosurePoint(x_0) of z^{-1}(V), and let t=s followed by z restricted to V. The proved Galois-category theorem supplies faithfulness of the geometric fibre functor at t because V is connected. For a geometric point y of a finite etale P over t, form c=(y,s):Spec(Omega)->P times_V z^{-1}(V) by the pullback universal property. Equality of the base-changed cover morphisms, precomposed with c and followed by the target first projection, is exactly equality of their values on y. Extensionality therefore gives equality of their fibre maps, and faithful fibre implies equality of the original cover morphisms. The argument works for empty P, with an empty quantification over y.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EY9, structure-sheaf comparison; its consequence that V is connected is combined with the already proved faithful geometric-fibre functor instead of completing internal Hom bundles.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtale_powerSeries_punctured_section_restriction_injective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    let z := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))
    ∀ P Q : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale,
      Function.Injective ((FiniteEtale.pullback (z ∣_ V)).map (X := P) (Y := Q))
